item.title: The Santa Rosa Original Certified Farmers Market — Sat Nov 21, 12:00 AM — Luther Burbank Center for the Arts
item.description: The Santa Rosa Original Certified Farmers Market is a year-round Saturday tradition in Sonoma County, bringing together local farmers, ranchers, food artisans, and neighbors from 8:30 a.m. to 1 p.m. This is not just a place to shop, it's a place to connect directly with the people who grow your food. As a Slow Food Sonoma County award recipient, the market prioritizes integrity, seasonality, and true farm-to-community relationships. Expect peak-season produce harvested just hours before market, pasture-raised meats, fresh flowers, artisan breads, handcrafted goods, and thoughtfully prepared foods that reflect the region's agricultural richness. Visitors can stroll the vibrant open-air market, sample local flavors, and experience Sonoma County's food culture in its most authentic form. Families, chefs, and weekend explorers alike gather here to discover what's growing now and to support small farms that keep our local food system strong. item.title: UC Master Gardeners: All About Growing Beautiful Orchids — Sat Nov 21, 10:30 AM — Northwest Santa Rosa Library
item.description:
Orchids are the largest family of flowering plants in the world, with over 25,000 species found in nature, and probably in the order of 150,000 different hybrids. Many think orchids are difficult to grow, but with some basic information, anyone can be successful with growing orchids. This presentation will cover: Understanding the basic needs and care for growing most orchids at home. An introduction to the more common orchid groups that are possible to grow. Learning which types can grow outside on the Sonoma Coast. Registration Encouraged: Visit Upcoming Events to complete your registration. After registering, you will receive a confirmation email containing information about attending the library talk. Learn about home gardening, pest management, water conservation practices, and more from your Sonoma County UC Master Gardeners! Different presentation topic per location.
Source: North Bay Bohemian

item.title: Grounded: A Balance + Stability Workshop at Cabuya Yoga — Sun Nov 22, 2:00 PM — Cabuya Yoga + Fitness
item.description:
Grounded: A Balance + Stability Workshop with Stephanie – $45
Cabuya Yoga + Fitness • Santa Rosa, CA | Sunday, Nov 22 • 02:00 PM – 03:30 PM PST
with Stephanie Koffler
The Sunday before Thanksgiving, give yourself somewhere steady to stand.
Who it’s for: All levels. No advanced experience needed, just curiosity and a sense of play.
The holidays have a way of pulling us off center. Travel, family, full calendars, and everyone wanting a piece of you. This workshop is ninety minutes to find your footing first, in your body and in your head, before the season sweeps you up.
We’ll treat balance as something you build, not something you either have or don’t. Through strength, mobility, breath, and focus, Stephanie will take it apart piece by piece and help you put it back together.
